notes.title: Terra Update 1.5 - The Drowned King *Important update information inside*
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

First off, Happy new year! I hope you all had an awesome Christmas time and are enjoying the new year so far.

What's in Terra 1.5
The 1.5 update will contain the following:


    Bug fixes galore - The blasted battle crash. Most of you know as G_Battle_System_Area - Invalid integer.
    Battle system update - More balanced, timing improved.
    Collision improvements - Slightly less clumsy when exploring the map.
    Updated graphics - Some earlier game sprites for example - Lots of early game content was drawn ages ago.  My pixel art has been improving over the dev time. So I switched out some bits and also commissioned some new improved item sprites.
    More monsters and variations! - Hunting a larger variety of monsters is always cool right?
    More story - Now you can progress further into the story.
    More in game content - Towns, items, recruitable characters, battle pets and more.
    More lore - Learn more about the world and history of Terra.
Also - Every recruitable character in Terra has back story that will be explored through side quests. A couple of these side quests can be sought out and completed in 1.5



Wait! So it's not finished?
No. It's not done. I have the content for the rest of the game implemented, but getting it all working and spending time to test it all, is long hard work. Don't get me wrong, I love doing it. But I'm going to be straight, I have a way to go. 

When EXACTLY will 1.5 ACTUALLY go live?
Any day now. It could be tomorrow, or the day after, or even the day after. I absolutely have to get this smoothed out and fully, 100% playable with no game killing bugs. It's done, it's in testing and it's at the last hurdle before I roll it out on Steam.

Why is it called 'The Drowned King' - Did the game name change?
This is the name of the update, it's because there is a major side quest called 'The Drowned King' in game now. It's been my favourite side quest to write and design. No spoilers so don't ask ;)
From here on out until the final version is live on Steam, each update will be thoroughly packed with content. Each content update will have a new name.

About the delays with content updates
As most of you will know, Terra has had a long and bumpy development road. Loads of delays and content updates pushed way back. I know this sucks and I can't make any excuses for it. Instead of just making excuses, I'd like to share a bit of my story with you all.

At the start of the development for Terra, years ago. I was massively unprepared for the development journey ahead. Like a lot of devs, I had worked on small games, as a part of small teams, mostly small jobs. Going solo on this project was crazy, when I look back I feel anxious about how much work I set myself up for. The C# to RM engine switch, the story writing, the pixel art (Before I could afford to commission a couple of artists to help me) and the game design in general. I vastly underestimated my workload, all while trying to run Back To Basics Gaming (We publish indie games) which pay the bills. 

Anything else?
The story and script for Terra 2 is mostly written. This was done a long time ago. And I can promise everyone that has supported Terra 1 will get a free Steam key. I'm happy to do this as a thank you for being patient and supportive. I appreciate it more than you guys know.

Thanks,
Dan.
:PugLove:

notes.title: Scrolls
notes.content:
What are scrolls?
 
Scrolls are powerful and mysterious equippable items in Terra.

Each character has a starter scroll. Starter scrolls have one hidden power and it will remain the same on any character equipping it. 

When you start to explore the game a bit more and find other scrolls, you'll learn that scrolls are cool because they don't only give stat boosts, which you can view in gear, but they also give random effects for different party members. You cannot view the random or hidden abilities, you'll need to test out different scroll set ups in battle to find out what they do. 

So if you equip a scroll on Alexis, it wont necessarily give the same stat boost and abilities to Frann or Leon. 

You can complete side quests and explore Terra to find more scrolls, some will also be obtained throughout the main story.

Here is an example of a starter scroll.

So, this one is Leon's starter scroll 'Nature's Writ'
http://i60.tinypic.com/11156o4.png

You can see that it gives a fairly good stat boost. The description sometimes hints at the hidden power contained within the scroll, but again, the hidden power can vary, depending on who has it equipped. Remember this doesn't apply to starter scrolls, with starter scrolls, the hidden ability will remain the same for whoever has it equipped.

Can you guess what this scrolls hidden power is?
I'll let you in on a secret, only read if you don't mind spoilers.

[spoiler]Nature's Writ gives the person equipping it protection from Earth element attacks/magia. Actually, it reduces damage from Earth element attacks/magia by 95%[/spoiler]

notes.title: Terra beta 1.2.4 is here!
notes.content:
Terra Incognita beta 1.2.4 is finally here, I'm so sorry for the long wait guys, but I've really had to clean the game up and remove the bugs before I progress with building new in-game areas.
Thanks for your patience, you're awesome!

Please note, when updating to Terra beta 1.2.4 you will need to restart your game, old save files will crash your game. If you're having any problems doing this, to remove old save files, go to 'C:\Users\appdata\Roaming\Terra Incognita Beta 1.2' and delete the saves manually. Of course, you don't need to delete the old saves, just don't load them and play, as soon as you get into a battle the game will crash. You can also just overwrite old saves with new to avoid this issue.

Fixes

    Fixed horrid invisible collision, sorry about that guys.
    Fixed numerous grammatical errors and excessive use of ......
    Cleaned up the code, this should increase frame rate and reduce any lag/screen tearing.
    Fixed 'Integer floating' crash.
    Fixed 'Stats resetting after load' crash
    Fixed 'Achievement bug' some people not able to get certain achievements.
    Cleaned up some sloppy animation.
    Balanced enemy stats, battles aren't so hard early on now.
    Fixed Windows 8 start-up freeze.
    Fixed treasure chest not opening in Wilderness.


New stuff
    Brand new opening scene artwork, much more detailed pixel art.
    Completely redesigned menus and battle UI.
    Completely changed the way collision works, you should now slide along edges. Reduced invisible collision.
    Removed the previous menu options, streamlined menu options.
    All magia now comes under a single 'Magia' tab in battle.
    Animated water/lava/fogs.
    New magia abilities for all characters.
    New Items/weapons and Gear to find and equip.
    New achievements.
    New areas to explore. *More areas will come on a weekly basis from now on.
    Added scrolls to the game*Please see scrolls announcement for details*
    Battle system is now faster, with next to NO wait time between turns. Battles are much quicker and not tedious.

notes.title: Update 1.2.4 incoming
notes.content:
Hey guys, 
I know it's been a while since the last update. From now on the core code wont be changing, so the updates will introduce new areas, characters, quest and story progression on a weekly basis. Sometimes twice a week.

This update addresses a lot of the complaints from beta 1.2.3 build(first major release on Steam)
I've fixed bugs, upgraded UIs, balanced stats, enemies and removed as best I can all that horrid, invisible collision. Basically, it's twice the game now.

I'll delete this and post a proper announcement with all the update details very shortly, sorry for the wait. Cheers for being awesome!

Dan

notes.title: Beta 1.2.3 update!
notes.content:
Beta 1.2.3 ~ updates and Fixes

Updated 10th Feb 2015

New stuff:
- Much improved battle UI
- Added massively requested Sprint mechanic. Just hold the shift key or reassign key/game pad controls with F1. No running in doors, It's dangerous guys....
- New style of looting treasure chests.
- Increased battle speed by about 15% with faster animations, less wait time between turns and moves.
- Added 'Game setting' at the main menu and in-game menu, change volume settings and window resolution.
- Added battle music.
- Removed typical RPG 'Statistic' tab from in-game menu, replaced with Gear/stats. Now check your stats there.

Fixes:
- Fixed save/load bug forever! (hopefully)
- Fixed 'Cannot locate/draw bitmap' crash error after a small percentage of battles.
- Fixed stat reset bug, when loading previous build save file. Now you can load your game from a previous build without it messing up stats.
- Fixed Windows 8.1 issue.
- Fixed fast scrolling text, causing player to miss text.

notes.title: beta 1.2.1 update ~
notes.content:
1.2.1 will be coming today hopefully.
The next update will fix the following issues:


    Occasional crashes before random battle encounters.
    Crash when using healing spell outside of battle.
    Cat meow playing constantly, causing crash   
    Fixed fishing clone issue
    Updated the battle UI, smarter, sleeker, cool.
    Fixed sorting bug for items, now items are sorted between loot and potions/food. Select Potions/food to use healing items outside of battle.
    Fixed glitch with falling through the ground in North Willow Tavern, strange one.
    Balanced monsters in the floating forest area at start of game. Lot's of people say too hard. Only slightly reducing monster HP and ATT stats.
